claim_boundary: Even if replicated, do not claim that all replay/counterfactual defenses fail on free text. The supported claim is limited to argument-role-dependent replay volatility under this P2b reconstruction unless a separate matched cross-defense experiment is frozen.

classes.OPAQUE_EXACT: Opaque exact values with no semantic paraphrase allowance in this population: password.
classes.OPEN_TEXT: Human-language/free-form values whose surface realization can vary while remaining semantically similar: body, content, subject/title/description, and free-form address/location text.
classes.REFERENCE_IDENTITY: Arguments selecting a principal/resource/recipient/channel/event: recipient(s), participants, user/email, channel, event_id.
classes.STRUCTURED_SCALAR: Format-constrained scalar values where serialization/canonicalization matters: amount, date/time strings, URL.

conditioning_rule: Argument-role exactness is estimated only when exactly one candidate call has the target function. That target call may coexist with extra non-target calls; those extra calls are recorded separately as action-structure instability.
cross_model_replication_rule: A directional contrast is called cross-family directionally replicated only if its decision-level point estimate has the preregistered sign in all three authoritative v1.3 arms. Report each model's decision-bootstrap CI separately; do not treat repeats or the three model families as independent mass-sample units.
origin: Discovery-derived replication hypothesis motivated by post-hoc Qwen-native P2b-v1 failure anatomy and AttriGuard replay-route diagnostics. Those old observations remain post-hoc; only v1.3 can provide prospective cross-model replication evidence.

primary_secondary_contrasts.name: OPEN_TEXT_minus_REFERENCE_IDENTITY
primary_secondary_contrasts.rationale: Within the same decision, open/generated textual arguments are predicted to be less exactly reproducible than identity/reference arguments.

primary_secondary_contrasts.name: STRUCTURED_SCALAR_minus_REFERENCE_IDENTITY
primary_secondary_contrasts.rationale: Within the same decision, format-sensitive scalar arguments are predicted to be less exactly reproducible than identity/reference arguments.

scientific_question: Conditional on locating a unique regenerated call to the original target function, does exact argument preservation differ by the semantic role of the target argument?
slot_comparison_rule: Use strict canonical JSON equality only. No embedding/LLM semantic adjudication is introduced in this endpoint. This endpoint measures replay exactness/volatility, not semantic task equivalence.
